title: Scenario 2 (Translation Project V25.1 on V1.003, experimental)
effect_mapping_evidence: Verified v24 X014 load wrapper 0608972C resolves a spell/special file ID through 06098244, then calls BOOT 060124B8 with that ID in r4 and destination 06049000 in r5. The effect update calls 06049000 at 0608B040. A recorded Healing Drop route loads X3ITEM at this address: the entire image matches crash RAM in the previous build; the candidate executes the animation and reaches the next turn. Only X3 images whose complete export veneers point inside their verified image qualify; X3ELEM5 remains under review. Other family members have static loader evidence, not executed spell coverage.

modules.name: BOOT
modules.evidence: IP first-read address; 06010338 observed as native boot callback at VBlank 13; additional callback candidates uniquely match 64 bytes of previously traced Scenario 1 functions. Static candidates are not executed coverage.; 06016C74 observed on native boot, 64 target bytes exact in mapped image.; 0601037C observed on native boot, 64 target bytes exact in mapped image.; 06015F9C observed on native boot, 64 target bytes exact in mapped image.; V1.003 base: the BOOT (1ST.BIN) differs from V2.000, which the v24 seeds were taken from. Seeds 0600E160, 0600E6F2, 06010338, 0601037C, 06013078, 060143AC, 0601564A, 06015F9C, 06016C74, 06020BDC were relocated to 0600E670, 0600EC02, 06010708, 0601074C, 0601349C, 060147D0, 06015A6E, 06015FEC, 06016CBC, 06020C24 by unique 16-64-byte matches of the V2.000 code at each seed (consistent per-region deltas); the other seeds and the three stack_return_calls are byte-identical at the same addresses.
modules.stack_return_evidence: Three drawing-command wrappers save the caller PR immediately before calling the shared queue guard. Its full-queue branch deliberately pops that saved PR and returns past the wrapper; accept only the exact one-word stack pop to the saved caller address. Other unexpected returns remain checked. The three equivalent helper bodies and all direct callers were verified in each registered revision.
